cases.title: Automatic Joke Fetch on Page Load
cases.description: Verify that upon loading the webpage, the system automatically initiates a fetch request to the API and displays the random dad joke in the designated element with data-testid='joke'.

cases.title: Fetch New Joke on Button Click
cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'Get Another Joke' button (data-testid='get-another-joke-button') asynchronously fetches a new random dad joke and displays it in the joke container (data-testid='joke').

cases.title: Replace Placeholder or Previous Joke on Button Click
cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'Get Another Joke' button correctly replaces either the initial placeholder text '// Joke goes here' or the previously displayed joke with the newly fetched joke in the container (data-testid='joke').

opinions.feedback: All proposed cases are clear, distinct, cover all requirements fully, and are completely testable without any blockers.
All cases and requirements are fully consistent, clear, and testable. No blockers identified.

analysis.analysis: e2edev_bench_12-R-1: Testable behavior includes automatic fetch on page load and rendering in element with data-testid='joke'. Normal path is successful API response display; abnormal paths include network failure or API error. Boundary: initial load state before fetch resolves. e2edev_bench_12-R-2: Testable behavior is clicking button with data-testid='get-another-joke-button' triggering asynchronous fetch and update of data-testid='joke'. Normal path is successful retrieval and display of a new joke; abnormal path is network failure during click action. e2edev_bench_12-R-3: Testable behavior is replacement of existing content (placeholder '// Joke goes here' or previous joke) with the newly fetched joke upon clicking the 'Get Another Joke' button. Boundary conditions include initial placeholder state vs. subsequent populated states. Ambiguity across R-2 and R-3: R-3 adds explicit mention of replacing the placeholder or previous joke, which is a refinement of R-2's update behavior.
